source_evidence: You may actually only be able to sell a certain percentage of the shares you request to have repurchased.
question: Misconception: I can sell all my interval fund shares whenever the next repurchase offer comes around.
answer: Not necessarily. Interval funds make repurchase offers only periodically, and they repurchase only a limited percentage of outstanding shares. If requests exceed the amount available, you may be able to sell only part of the shares you requested, so you may need to keep holding the rest until a later offer.
